gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies the exact algorithmic defect: the angular deviation d is compared against the cosine-scale quantity 1/sqrt(n), causing both extremal and nonextremal classifications to be wrong. Its repair explicitly replaces the threshold with arccos(1/sqrt(n)), matching the gold defect and correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Algorithm 2 uses 1/sqrt(n) as the threshold for the angular quantity d instead of the conjectured angular bound arccos(1/sqrt(n)), so both predicates misclassify candidates.

component_coverage.gold_component: The two Algorithm 2 predicates compare the angular deviation d against the wrong cosine-scale threshold 1/sqrt(n), misclassifying exact extremal inputs and nonextremal values.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction states that d is an angle, contrasts it with the cosine 1/sqrt(n), gives the n=2 counterexample and both predicate consequences, and supplies the exact angular-scale repair. It independently diagnoses the full gold concern.
